svg.text: DETAIL 6 / A6.01 — STONE WALL TRANSITION TO METAL STANDING SEAM ROOF
100% CD MARK-UP — NOTES TO ADD (TEXT AS SHOWN) + DRAWING ELEMENTS TO ADD
= DRAWING ELEMENT MISSING FROM THE CURRENT DETAIL — DRAW IT, THEN NOTE IT.
SLOPE — SEE ROOF PLAN
T.O. ROOF PANEL EL. = ___
EXT.
INT.
R2
STONE VENEER — TYPE, THICKNESS, FINISH AND
JOINT SIZE PER SPEC. ANCHORAGE PER
ENGINEERED SHOP DRAWINGS (DEFERRED
SUBMITTAL, SIGNED AND SEALED).
W10 — VERIFY WALL ASSEMBLY TAG AGAINST
ASSEMBLY SCHEDULE; CONFIRM IT CARRIES THE
STONE, CAVITY, INSULATION AND AIR BARRIER
SHOWN HERE.
STONE ANCHOR — STAINLESS, THERMALLY ISOLATED, TYPE
AND SPACING PER STONE ENGINEER. SEAL EVERY
PENETRATION THROUGH THE AIR / WATER BARRIER.
1" MIN. CLEAR DRAINAGE CAVITY — KEEP FREE OF
MORTAR DROPPINGS.
MORTAR NET / DRAINAGE MESH AT BASE OF CAVITY.
WEEP VENTS @ 24" O.C. MAX. IN FIRST JOINT ABOVE
FLASHING.
SEALANT AND BACKER ROD AT COUNTERFLASHING HEAD
JOINT.
STANDING SEAM METAL ROOF PANEL — 24 GA.
PREFINISHED (PVDF), __" WIDE, __" SEAM HT.,
CONCEALED FLOATING CLIPS @ __" O.C. PER UPLIFT
CALCULATIONS.
CONCEALED CLIP AT EACH SEAM — ALLOW FOR THERMAL
MOVEMENT; DO NOT PIN PANEL AT BOTH ENDS.
HIGH-TEMPERATURE SELF-ADHERED UNDERLAYMENT (240°F
MIN.) — FULL COVERAGE, 3" SIDE / 6" END LAPS. TURN
UP WALL 8" MIN. BEHIND BASE FLASHING.
SLIP SHEET / ROSIN PAPER BETWEEN UNDERLAYMENT AND
PANEL.
COVER BOARD, 1/2" GLASS-MAT GYPSUM, MECHANICALLY
FASTENED.
RIGID INSULATION — TWO LAYERS, JOINTS STAGGERED,
R-__ MIN. TOTAL PER ENERGY CODE.
AIR / VAPOR BARRIER OVER DECK — CONTINUOUS; TURN
UP FACE OF CONCRETE WALL AND LAP WITH WALL AIR
BARRIER 3" MIN.
STRUCTURAL CONCRETE ROOF DECK — SEE STRUCTURAL.
SLOPE PER ROOF PLAN.
CONCRETE WALL — SEE STRUCTURAL FOR THICKNESS, REINFORCING
AND ANCHOR EMBEDMENT.
CONTINUOUS RIGID INSULATION ON WALL — R-__ MIN.; RUN
CONTINUOUS INTO ROOF INSULATION WITH NO GAP AT THE CORNER.
FILL VOIDS W/ SPRAY FOAM.
AIR / WATER BARRIER ON CONCRETE FACE — CONTINUOUS FROM
ROOF AIR BARRIER UP THE WALL; LAP AND SEAL ALL
TRANSITIONS.
SHELF / RELIEVING ANGLE AT BASE OF VENEER — SIZE, ANCHORS
AND THERMAL ISOLATION PER STRUCTURAL. CONFIRM VENEER IS
SUPPORTED AT THIS LEVEL.
STAINLESS THROUGH-WALL FLASHING W/ END DAMS — LAP UNDER
WALL AIR BARRIER, TURN DOWN AS COUNTERFLASHING OVER BASE
FLASHING, 4" MIN. LAP, HEMMED DRIP EDGE.
CONTINUOUS TREATED BLOCKING OR METAL SUB-GIRT FOR BASE
FLASHING ATTACHMENT — FASTEN THROUGH INSULATION TO
CONCRETE.
BASE FLASHING — 24 GA., TURN UP 8" MIN. ABOVE FINISHED
ROOF SURFACE, HEMMED TOP AND BOTTOM EDGES, LAP JOINTS 4"
MIN. W/ SEALANT.
PANEL END — HEM UP 2" MIN. INTO CONTINUOUS OFFSET CLEAT AT
WALL; NO EXPOSED FASTENERS IN PANEL PAN.
R2 — VERIFY ROOF ASSEMBLY TAG AGAINST ASSEMBLY SCHEDULE.
GENERAL NOTES — THIS DETAIL
ROOF ASSEMBLY TO BE UL 790 CLASS 'A' AND TESTED FOR UPLIFT PER ASTM E1592 / UL 580
CLASS 90. SUBMIT UPLIFT CALCULATIONS SIGNED BY A LICENSED ENGINEER.
STANDING SEAM PANELS: VERIFY MIN. ROOF SLOPE AGAINST PANEL PROFILE (HYDROKINETIC VS.
HYDROSTATIC / SEAM-SEALED) AND MFR. REQUIREMENTS.
ALL FLASHING SAME METAL AND FINISH FAMILY; ISOLATE DISSIMILAR METALS W/ SEPARATION
TAPE OR COATING.
FLASHING TURN-UP AT ALL WALL TRANSITIONS 8" MIN. ABOVE FINISHED ROOF SURFACE; 12"
MIN. WHERE DRIFTING OCCURS.
END DAMS AND SOLDERED / SEALED CORNERS AT ALL FLASHING TERMINATIONS AND DIRECTION
CHANGES.
MAINTAIN CONTINUOUS AIR BARRIER FROM ROOF DECK TO WALL — SEAL ALL ANCHOR AND
FASTENER PENETRATIONS.
PROVIDE 4'-0" LONG MOCK-UP OF THIS TRANSITION, INCLUDING STONE, FLASHING AND PANEL
END, FOR REVIEW PRIOR TO PROCEEDING.
PROTECT PANEL FINISH DURING STONE WORK; CLEAN MORTAR FROM PANELS AND FLASHING
IMMEDIATELY.
COORDINATE SNOW RETENTION, IF REQUIRED, W/ ROOF PLAN — DO NOT PENETRATE PANELS;
CLAMP-ON AT SEAMS ONLY.
VERIFY / COORDINATE BEFORE ISSUE
— HEADWALL OR SIDEWALL? IF SLOPE RUNS PARALLEL TO THE
WALL, ADD STEP FLASHING AND A KICKOUT AT THE LOW END
— ROOF SLOPE + PANEL PROFILE (SEAM TYPE, WIDTH, GAUGE,
FINISH)
— STONE VENEER SUPPORT LEVEL — SHELF ANGLE HERE OR
BEARING BELOW
— SNOW DRIFT / SNOW RETENTION REQUIREMENTS
— CLEARANCE, BOTTOM OF STONE TO ROOF SURFACE (8" MIN.
RECOMMENDED)
— W10 / R2 TAGS AGREE W/ ASSEMBLY SCHEDULE
STONE WALL TRANSITION TO METAL STANDING SEAM ROOF
